description: Change a term's, a claim's or a set's link on other sites (PM-1168) — the sites that may show it, its term — keeping the link, so the sites that have it keep working; for a set also its name, and its 'terms' or 'claims', each given replacing that part of the list (a term on it you may not open stays on it). Only what you pass changes: an empty 'sites' allows any site, days 0 removes the term. Only for somebody who may write in the project; a line in its history.

claims.description: A set's claims, comma-separated, replacing its claims.

days.description: A new term in days from now; 0 is until it is removed.

embedId.description: The embed's id, from list_registry_embeds or a create_*_embed.

sites.description: Sites that may show it, comma-separated; empty is any site.

terms.description: A set's terms, comma-separated, replacing its terms.

name: update_registry_embed
title: Update registry embed
